description:
Change a Studio video by asking, as the human would in the chat.
Only what the ask names changes; Siren replies with what it changed
(before and after) and the new version number. Waits up to about 25
seconds for the reply. No credits are spent until studio_export. A greeting
or a question gets an answer and no new version.

attachments.description: Optional files to use: URLs from upload_media (a screenshot to show, a logo to put in, a reference). Up to 6.

text.description: The change, in plain words: "shorter hook", "show the timer first", "use our orange", "make it vertical". May be empty when attachments say it all.

thread_id.description: The thread id from studio_start or studio_threads.

name: studio_edit
